# Simulations

## Helpers

```{r}

# ============================================================
# SHARED HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

# SIR simulation model (odin2)
simple_sir <- odin2::odin({
  N      <- parameter()
  I0     <- parameter()
  gamma  <- parameter()
  n_beta <- parameter()
  beta_times  <- parameter()
  beta_values <- parameter()
  dim(beta_times)  <- n_beta
  dim(beta_values) <- n_beta
  beta_t <- interpolate(beta_times, beta_values, "constant")
  initial(S) <- N - I0
  initial(I) <- I0
  initial(incidence, zero_every = 1) <- 0
  p_SI <- 1 - exp(-beta_t * I / N * dt)
  p_IR <- 1 - exp(-gamma * dt)
  n_SI <- S * p_SI
  n_IR <- I * p_IR
  update(S) <- S - n_SI
  update(I) <- I + n_SI - n_IR
  update(incidence) <- n_SI
  cases <- data()
  cases ~ Poisson(incidence)
})

simulate_epidemic <- function(N, gamma, I0, beta_values, beta_times,
                              T = 150, seed = 444) {
  set.seed(seed)
  obj  <- simple_sir()
  pars <- list(N = N, I0 = I0, gamma = gamma,
               n_beta = length(beta_values),
               beta_times = beta_times, beta_values = beta_values)
  sys <- dust2::dust_system_create(obj, pars, n_particles = 1, dt = 1)
  dust2::dust_system_set_state_initial(sys)
  y <- dust2::dust_system_simulate(sys, 0:T)
  list(
    incidence_df = data.frame(time  = 1:T,
                              cases = rpois(T, y[3, -1])),
    S_true       = y[1, -1],
    inc_true     = y[3, -1]
  )
}

compute_true_Rt <- function(beta_values, beta_times, gamma,
                            S_true, N, T = 150) {
  beta_t <- approx(beta_times + 1, beta_values, 1:T,
                   method = "constant", f = 0, rule = 2)$y
  (beta_t / gamma) * (S_true / N)
}

fit_scenario <- function(incidence_df, N, gamma, beta_breaks,
                         mean_beta, sd_beta = 0.7,
                         rw_sd_beta = 0.2,
                         mean_I0, sd_I0 = 0.5,
                         n_steps = 15000, n_chains = 3) {
  estimate_R_blocks(
    data        = incidence_df,
    N           = N,
    gamma       = gamma,
    beta_breaks = beta_breaks,
    priors = list(mean_beta  = mean_beta, sd_beta    = sd_beta,
                  rw_sd_beta = rw_sd_beta,
                  mean_I0    = mean_I0,   sd_I0      = sd_I0),
    inits  = list(beta = exp(mean_beta),  I0 = exp(mean_I0)),
    mcmc   = list(n_steps = n_steps, burnin = 0.5,
                  seed = 444, n_chains = n_chains)
  )
}

coverage_stats <- function(Rt_true, lwr, upr, med,
                           scenario, label = "") {
  n       <- min(length(Rt_true), length(lwr), length(upr), length(med))
  covered <- Rt_true[1:n] >= lwr[1:n] & Rt_true[1:n] <= upr[1:n]
  data.frame(
    Scenario  = label,
    `Coverage (%)` = round(mean(covered) * 100, 1),
    `Mean bias`    = round(mean(med[1:n] - Rt_true[1:n]), 3),
    RMSE           = round(sqrt(mean((med[1:n] - Rt_true[1:n])^2)), 3),
    `Mean CI width`= round(mean(upr[1:n] - lwr[1:n]), 3),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

```

## Simulate and fit

```{r}

# ============================================================
# SIMULATE
# ============================================================
cat("Simulating epidemics...\n")
sim1 <- simulate_epidemic(s1$N, s1$gamma, s1$I0, s1$beta_values, s1$beta_times)
sim2 <- simulate_epidemic(s2$N, s2$gamma, s2$I0, s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times)
sim3 <- simulate_epidemic(s3$N, s3$gamma, s3$I0, s3$beta_values, s3$beta_times)

Rt_true_s1 <- compute_true_Rt(s1$beta_values, s1$beta_times, s1$gamma, sim1$S_true, s1$N)
Rt_true_s2 <- compute_true_Rt(s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times, s2$gamma, sim2$S_true, s2$N)
Rt_true_s3 <- compute_true_Rt(s3$beta_values, s3$beta_times, s3$gamma, sim3$S_true, s3$N)

true_df_s1 <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_s1)
true_df_s2 <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_s2)
true_df_s3 <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_s3)

# ============================================================
# FIT MAIN SCENARIOS
# ============================================================
cat("Fitting S1 (N=5,000, joint I0)...\n")
out_s1 <- fit_scenario(sim1$incidence_df, s1$N, s1$gamma, s1$beta_breaks,
                       s1$mean_beta, mean_I0 = s1$mean_I0, sd_I0 = s1$sd_I0)

cat("Fitting S2 (N=100,000, fixed I0)...\n")
out_s2 <- fit_scenario(sim2$incidence_df, s2$N, s2$gamma, s2$beta_breaks,
                       s2$mean_beta, mean_I0 = s2$mean_I0, sd_I0 = s2$sd_I0)

cat("Fitting S3 (N=10,000,000, joint I0)...\n")
out_s3 <- fit_scenario(sim3$incidence_df, s3$N, s3$gamma, s3$beta_breaks,
                       s3$mean_beta, mean_I0 = s3$mean_I0, sd_I0 = s3$sd_I0)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FIGURE 1-3: Rt RECOVERY — one per scenario
# ============================================================

make_rt_recovery_plot <- function(out, true_df, s, subtitle_note = "") {
  subtitle <- if (nchar(subtitle_note) > 0) subtitle_note else NULL
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = out$Rt_quantiles,
                aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = s$colour, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(data = out$Rt_quantiles,
              aes(x = time, y = median, colour = "Posterior median"),
              linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_line(data = true_df,
              aes(x = time, y = Rt, colour = "True Rt"),
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = s$vlines, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,3)) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      name   = NULL,
      values = c("Posterior median" = s$colour,
                 "True Rt"          = "black"),
      guide  = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(linetype = c("solid", "dashed"),
                            linewidth = c(1.0, 0.9))
      ) 
    ) +
    
 labs(
      title    = s$label,                            # short scenario title
      subtitle = paste0("N = ", format(s$N, big.mark=",")),  # put N here
      x = "Time (days)", 
      y = expression(R[t])
    ) +

    theme_thesis +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

# Empirical validation

## Helpers :)

```{r}

# ============================================================
# EMPIRICAL DATASETS
# ============================================================

# ---- Helper: extract blockwise beta(t) summary from beta_t_mat ----
extract_beta_blocks <- function(out) {
  beta_mat <- out$beta_t_mat
  bt       <- out$beta_times
  time_vec <- out$Rt_quantiles$time
  K        <- length(bt)
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
    t_start <- bt[k]
    t_end   <- if (k < K) bt[k + 1] - 1 else max(time_vec)
    idx     <- which(time_vec >= t_start & time_vec <= t_end)
    draws   <- beta_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(t_start = t_start, t_end = t_end,
               median = median(draws),
               lower  = quantile(draws, 0.025),
               upper  = quantile(draws, 0.975))
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# ---- Helper: EpiEstim block summary ----
epi_block_summary <- function(res) {
  res$R |>
    transmute(t_start, t_end,
              Mean  = `Mean(R)`,
              Lower = `Quantile.0.025(R)`,
              Upper = `Quantile.0.975(R)`)
}

# ---- Helper: rodent Rt_mat block summary ----
# ---- Helper: rodent Rt_mat block summary *by user breaks* ----
rodent_block_summary_by_breaks <- function(out, breaks) {
  Rt_mat   <- out$Rt_mat
  time_vec <- out$Rt_quantiles$time
  K        <- length(breaks)
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
    t_start <- breaks[k]
    t_end   <- if (k < K) breaks[k + 1] - 1L else max(time_vec)
    idx     <- which(time_vec >= t_start & time_vec <= t_end)
    draws   <- Rt_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(
      t_start = t_start, t_end = t_end,
      Mean    = mean(draws),
      Lower   = as.numeric(quantile(draws, 0.025)),
      Upper   = as.numeric(quantile(draws, 0.975))
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# ---- Helper: block comparison plot ----
make_block_comparison <- function(df_epi, df_rod, vlines, title) {
  span  <- max(df_rod$t_end) - min(df_rod$t_start)
  shift <- 0.02 * span
  df <- bind_rows(
    df_epi |> mutate(method = "EpiEstim",
                     x_start = t_start - shift, x_end = t_end - shift),
    df_rod |> mutate(method = "rodent",
                     x_start = t_start + shift, x_end = t_end + shift)
  )
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = x_end,
                  ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, fill = method),
              alpha = 0.3, colour = NA) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end,
                     y = Mean, yend = Mean, colour = method),
                 linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("EpiEstim" = COL_EPIESTIM,
                                  "rodent"   = COL_RODENT)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("EpiEstim" = COL_EPIESTIM,
                                   "rodent"   = COL_RODENT)) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = "Mean and 95% CI per block",
         x = "Time (days)", y = expression(R[t]),
         fill = NULL, colour = NULL) +
    theme_thesis
}

# ---- Helper: 2-panel smooth Rt ----
make_smooth_rt_two_panel <- function(out_rod, res_epi_slide,
                                     vlines, title,
                                     epi_subtitle,
                                     y_limits = c(0, 3)) {
  p_rod <- ggplot(out_rod$Rt_quantiles, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = COL_RODENT, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = COL_RODENT, linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
    labs(title = "rodent: smooth Rt(t)",
         subtitle = "Posterior median and 95% CI",
         x = "Time (days)", y = expression(R[t])) +
    theme_thesis + theme(legend.position = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)

  p_epi <- plot(res_epi_slide, "R") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
    labs(title    = "EpiEstim: sliding window Rt",
         subtitle = epi_subtitle,
         x = "Time (days)", y = expression(R[t])) +
    theme_thesis +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)

  (p_rod / p_epi) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = "Top: rodent  |  Bottom: EpiEstim",
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40")
      )
    )
}

# ---- Helper: 2-panel beta(t) + S(t) ----
make_beta_S_two_panel <- function(out, vlines, title) {
  df_beta <- extract_beta_blocks(out)

  p_beta <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = df_beta,
              aes(xmin = t_start, xmax = t_end, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = COL_BETA, alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_segment(data = df_beta,
                 aes(x = t_start, xend = t_end, y = median, yend = median),
                 colour = COL_BETA, linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "butt") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
    labs(title    = expression(paste(beta, "(t) — blockwise posterior")),
         subtitle = "Posterior median and 95% CI per block",
         x = "Time (days)", y = expression(beta(t))) +
    theme_thesis + theme(legend.position = "none",
                         panel.grid = element_blank())

  p_S <- ggplot(out$S_quantiles, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = COL_S, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = COL_S, linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
    labs(title    = "S(t) — susceptible trajectory",
         subtitle = "Posterior median and 95% CI",
         x = "Time (days)", y = "S(t)") +
    theme_thesis + theme(legend.position = "none")

  (p_beta / p_S) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = title,
      theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                       plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))
    )
}
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# FLU 2009 H1N1
# ============================================================
cat("\nLoading and fitting Flu 2009 H1N1...\n")

data(Flu2009)
flu_daily <- Flu2009$incidence |>
  mutate(time = row_number()) |>
  rename(cases = I) |>
  select(time, cases) |>
  as.data.frame()

flu_vlines <- c(8, 18, 25)
Tmax_flu   <- nrow(flu_daily)

out_flu <- estimate_R_blocks(
  data        = flu_daily,
  N           = 369,
  gamma       = 1 / 2.6,
  beta_breaks = c(1, 8, 18, 25),
  priors = list(mean_beta = log(0.5), sd_beta = 0.5,
                rw_sd_beta = 0.3, mean_I0 = log(5), sd_I0 = 0.5),
  inits  = list(beta = 0.5, I0 = 5),
  mcmc   = list(n_steps = 15000, burnin = 0.5,
                seed = 444, n_chains = 3)
)

# EpiEstim — sliding (7-day, non-parametric SI from Flu2009)
flu_epi_data <- flu_daily |> rename(I = cases)

res_flu_slide <- estimate_R(
  incid  = flu_epi_data,
  method = "non_parametric_si",
  config = make_config(si_distr = Flu2009$si_distr)
)

# EpiEstim — blocks matching rodent breaks
res_flu_blocks <- estimate_R(
  incid  = flu_epi_data,
  method = "non_parametric_si",
  config = make_config(
    si_distr = Flu2009$si_distr,
    t_start  = c(2, 8, 18, 25),
    t_end    = c(7, 17, 24, Tmax_flu)
  )
)

df_epi_flu_blocks <- epi_block_summary(res_flu_blocks)
df_rod_flu_blocks <- rodent_block_summary_by_breaks(out_flu, breaks = c(1, 8, 18, 25))

# FIGURE 6: Flu incidence
fig6 <- ggplot(flu_daily, aes(time, cases)) +
  geom_col(fill = COL_S, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = flu_vlines, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = 19, y = max(flu_daily$cases) * 0.92,
           label = "School\nclosure", hjust = 0, size = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(title    = "Influenza A(H1N1) 2009",
       subtitle = "Daily incidence  |  N = 369",
       x = "Time (days)", y = "Daily cases") +
  theme_thesis + theme(legend.position = "none")
print(fig6)

# FIGURE 7: Flu block Rt comparison
fig7 <- make_block_comparison(
  df_epi_flu_blocks, df_rod_flu_blocks, flu_vlines,
  "Blockwise Rt: EpiEstim vs rodent"
)
print(fig7)

# FIGURE 8: Flu smooth Rt two-panel
fig8 <- make_smooth_rt_two_panel(
  out_flu, res_flu_slide, flu_vlines,
  "Smooth Rt comparison",
  "Non-parametric SI  |  7-day sliding windows"
)
print(fig8)

# FIGURE 9: Flu beta(t) + S(t)
fig9 <- make_beta_S_two_panel(
  out_flu, flu_vlines,
  "\u03b2(t) and S(t)"
)
print(fig9)

# TABLE 2: Flu blockwise Rt
cat("\n========== TABLE 2: Flu 2009 H1N1 — Blockwise Rt ==========\n")
table2 <- data.frame(
  Block     = paste0("Days ", df_epi_flu_blocks$t_start, "–", df_epi_flu_blocks$t_end),
  EpiEstim  = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
                      df_epi_flu_blocks$Mean,
                      df_epi_flu_blocks$Lower,
                      df_epi_flu_blocks$Upper),
  rodent    = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
                      df_rod_flu_blocks$Mean,
                      df_rod_flu_blocks$Lower,
                      df_rod_flu_blocks$Upper)
)
print(knitr::kable(table2,
                   col.names = c("Time block", "EpiEstim mean [95% CI]", "rodent mean [95% CI]"),
                   caption = "Table 2. Block Rt estimates for Flu 2009 H1N1. EpiEstim uses non-parametric SI distribution from Flu2009$si_distr."))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MANUSCRIPT 4‑PANEL FIGURE (FIGS 6–9)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
# Extract individual panels from the smooth Rt two-panel figure
rodent_smooth  <- fig8[[1]]   # top panel
epiestim_smooth <- fig8[[2]]  # bottom panel

library(patchwork)

fig_flu_2x2 <-
  (fig6 + fig7) /
  (rodent_smooth + epiestim_smooth) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Influenza A(H1N1) 2009 — Transmission Summary",
    subtitle = "Top: incidence & blockwise Rt   |   Bottom: rodent smooth Rt & EpiEstim smooth Rt",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),

  )

# Export at journal-friendly size
ggsave("flu_2x2_core_rt.png", fig_flu_2x2,
       width = 180, height = 160, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

cat("\nLoading and fitting Ebola Sierra Leone 2014...\n")

data(ebola_sierraleone_2014)

  filter(!is.na(date_of_onset)) |>
  group_by(date_of_onset) |>
  summarise(cases = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(date_of_onset) |>
  mutate(time = row_number()) |>
  select(time, cases) |>
  as.data.frame()

ebola_vlines <- c(100, 180, 240)
Tmax_ebola   <- nrow(ebola_daily)

out_ebola <- estimate_R_blocks(
  data        = ebola_daily,
  N           = 6900000,
  gamma       = 0.1,
  beta_breaks = c(1, 100, 180, 240),
  priors = list(mean_beta = log(0.2), sd_beta = 0.5,
                rw_sd_beta = 0.3, mean_I0 = log(5), sd_I0 = 0.5),
  inits  = list(beta = 0.2, I0 = 5),
  mcmc   = list(n_steps = 15000, burnin = 0.5,
                seed = 444, n_chains = 3)
)

ebola_epi_data <- ebola_daily |> rename(I = cases)

# EpiEstim — 14-day sliding (SI mean > 7d so 14d window more stable)
res_ebola_slide <- estimate_R(
  incid  = ebola_epi_data,
  method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 14.2, std_si = 9.6,
    t_start = seq(2, Tmax_ebola - 13),
    t_end   = seq(2, Tmax_ebola - 13) + 13
  ))
)

# EpiEstim — blocks

  incid  = ebola_epi_data,
  method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 14.2, std_si = 9.6,
    t_start = c(2, 100, 180, 240),
    t_end   = c(99, 179, 239, Tmax_ebola)
  ))
)

df_epi_ebola_blocks <- epi_block_summary(res_ebola_blocks)
df_rod_ebola_blocks <- rodent_block_summary_by_breaks(out_ebola, breaks = c(1, 100, 180, 240))

             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = ebola_vlines + 2,
           y = rep(max(ebola_daily$cases) * 0.9, 3),
           label = paste0(1:3),
           hjust = 0, size = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(title    = "Daily incidence",
       subtitle = paste0("Date of symptom onset  |  N = 6,900,000")) +
  theme_thesis + theme(legend.position = "none")
print(fig10)

# FIGURE 11: Ebola block comparison

  df_epi_ebola_blocks, df_rod_ebola_blocks, ebola_vlines,

) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3))
print(fig11)

# FIGURE 12: Ebola smooth Rt two-panel
fig12 <- make_smooth_rt_two_panel(
  out_ebola, res_ebola_slide, ebola_vlines,

print(fig12)

# FIGURE 13: Ebola beta(t) + S(t)

                   caption = "Table 3. Block Rt estimates for Ebola Sierra Leone 2014. EpiEstim uses parametric SI (mean=14.2d, sd=9.6d)."))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURES

cat("\n\n--- Running supplementary analyses ---\n")

# ============================================================
# SUP 1: RW PRIOR SENSITIVITY (S1)
# ============================================================
cat("Sup 1: RW sensitivity (S1)...\n")

rw_regimes <- list(
  list(label = "P1: Weak (rw = 0.5)",      rw = 0.5,  col = "#56B4E9"),
  list(label = "P2: Moderate (rw = 0.2)",  rw = 0.2,  col = "#009E73"),
  list(label = "P3: Tighter (rw = 0.1)",   rw = 0.1,  col = "#CC79A7"),
  list(label = "P4: Tight (rw = 0.05)",    rw = 0.05, col = "#E69F00")
)

rw_runs  <- list()
rw_stats <- list()
for (r in rw_regimes) {
  fit <- fit_scenario(sim1$incidence_df, s1$N, s1$gamma, s1$beta_breaks,
                      s1$mean_beta, rw_sd_beta = r$rw,
                      mean_I0 = s1$mean_I0, sd_I0 = s1$sd_I0)
  rw_runs[[r$label]]  <- fit$Rt_quantiles |> mutate(regime = r$label)
  rw_stats[[r$label]] <- coverage_stats(
    Rt_true_s1, fit$Rt_quantiles$lwr, fit$Rt_quantiles$upr,
    fit$Rt_quantiles$median, "S1", r$label)
}

rw_df      <- bind_rows(rw_runs)
rw_cols    <- setNames(sapply(rw_regimes, `[[`, "col"),
                       sapply(rw_regimes, `[[`, "label"))

sup1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = rw_df,
              aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = regime),
              alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = rw_df,
            aes(x = time, y = median, colour = regime), linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_line(data = true_df_s1, aes(x = time, y = Rt),
            colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = s1$vlines, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rw_cols, name = "RW prior (rw_sd_beta)") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = rw_cols, name = "RW prior (rw_sd_beta)") +
  labs(title    = "RW prior sensitivity — S1 (N = 5,000)",
       subtitle = "Black dashed = true Rt",
       x = "Time (days)", y = expression(R[t])) +
  theme_thesis
print(sup1)

cat("\n--- Sup Table: RW sensitivity ---\n")
print(knitr::kable(bind_rows(rw_stats)))
```

## 4

```{r}

# ============================================================
# SUP 4: CHANGE-POINT TIMING SENSITIVITY (S2, N=10,000)
# ============================================================
cat("Sup 4: Change-point sensitivity (S2 profile, N=10,000)...\n")

N_cp  <- 10000
I0_cp <- max(1L, round(s2$I0 * (N_cp / s2$N)))
sim_cp <- simulate_epidemic(N_cp, s2$gamma, I0_cp,
                            s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times)
Rt_true_cp <- compute_true_Rt(s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times,
                              s2$gamma, sim_cp$S_true, N_cp)
true_df_cp <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_cp)

cp_variants <- list(
  list(label = "Correct",     breaks = s2$beta_breaks,          col = "#009E73"),
  list(label = "Early (-7d)", breaks = pmax(1, s2$beta_breaks - 7), col = "#E69F00"),
  list(label = "Late (+7d)",  breaks = s2$beta_breaks + 7,      col = "#56B4E9")
)

cp_runs  <- list()
cp_stats <- list()
for (cpv in cp_variants) {
  fit <- fit_scenario(sim_cp$incidence_df, N_cp, s2$gamma, cpv$breaks,
                      s2$mean_beta, mean_I0 = log(I0_cp), sd_I0 = 0.5)
  cp_runs[[cpv$label]]  <- fit$Rt_quantiles |> mutate(schedule = cpv$label)
  cp_stats[[cpv$label]] <- coverage_stats(
    Rt_true_cp, fit$Rt_quantiles$lwr, fit$Rt_quantiles$upr,
    fit$Rt_quantiles$median, "S2 N=10k", cpv$label)
}

cp_df   <- bind_rows(cp_runs)
cp_cols <- setNames(sapply(cp_variants, `[[`, "col"),
                    sapply(cp_variants, `[[`, "label"))

sup4 <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = cp_df,
              aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = schedule),
              alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = cp_df,
            aes(x = time, y = median, colour = schedule), linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_line(data = true_df_cp, aes(x = time, y = Rt),
            colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = s2$vlines, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cp_cols, name = "Break schedule") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cp_cols, name = "Break schedule") +
  labs(title    = "Change-point timing sensitivity (N = 10,000)",
       subtitle = "True change-point at day 45  |  Black dashed = true Rt",
       x = "Time (days)", y = expression(R[t])) +
  theme_thesis
print(sup4)

cat("\n--- Sup Table: CP sensitivity ---\n")
print(knitr::kable(bind_rows(cp_stats)))

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SUP 5: CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS (S1)
# ============================================================
cat("Sup 5: Convergence diagnostics (S1)...\n")

samp_arr  <- out_s1$samples$pars
par_names <- dimnames(samp_arr)[[1]]
if (is.null(par_names))
  par_names <- c(sprintf("beta_%d", seq_len(dim(samp_arr)[1] - 1)), "I0")

n_pars   <- dim(samp_arr)[1]
n_steps  <- dim(samp_arr)[2]
n_chains <- dim(samp_arr)[3]

trace_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(ch) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_pars), function(p) {
    data.frame(step  = seq_len(n_steps),
               value = samp_arr[p, , ch],
               param = par_names[p],
               chain = factor(ch))
  }))
}))

p_trace <- ggplot(trace_df, aes(x = step, y = value, colour = chain)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.35) +
  facet_wrap(~ param, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#009E73"),
                      name = "Chain") +
  labs(title    = "Trace plots — S1 (N = 5,000)",
       subtitle = "Post-burnin samples  |  Overlapping chains indicate good mixing",
       x = "Post-burnin iteration", y = "Value") +
  theme_thesis + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8))

mcmc_list <- coda::mcmc.list(
  lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(ch) {
    mat <- t(samp_arr[, , ch])
    colnames(mat) <- par_names
    coda::mcmc(mat)
  })
)
rhat_vals <- coda::gelman.diag(mcmc_list, multivariate = FALSE)$psrf
ess_vals  <- coda::effectiveSize(mcmc_list)

diag_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter   = par_names,
  R_hat       = round(rhat_vals[, 1], 3),
  R_hat_upper = round(rhat_vals[, 2], 3),
  ESS         = round(ess_vals, 0)
)

p_rhat <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = reorder(Parameter, R_hat), y = R_hat)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = R_hat < 1.05), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = R_hat, ymax = R_hat_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.01, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#009E73", "FALSE" = "#D55E00"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "< 1.05", "FALSE" = "\u2265 1.05"),
                    name = expression(hat(R))) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title    = expression(paste(hat(R), " convergence")),
       subtitle = "Red = 1.01 target",
       x = NULL, y = expression(hat(R))) +
  theme_thesis

p_ess <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = reorder(Parameter, ESS), y = ESS)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = ESS > 400), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 400, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#009E73", "FALSE" = "#D55E00"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "> 400", "FALSE" = "\u2264 400"),
                    name = "ESS") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title    = "Effective sample size",
       subtitle = "Red = 400 minimum",
       x = NULL, y = "ESS") +
  theme_thesis

sup5 <- (p_trace / (p_rhat | p_ess)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Supplementary Figure 5. MCMC convergence diagnostics — S1 (N = 5,000)",
    subtitle = "Top: trace plots across 3 chains  |  Bottom left: R-hat  |  Bottom right: ESS",
    theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
                     plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))
  )
print(sup5)

cat("\n========== Convergence diagnostics table ==========\n")
print(knitr::kable(diag_df,
                   caption = "Supplementary Table. MCMC convergence diagnostics for S1. R-hat < 1.01 indicates good convergence; ESS > 400 is practically sufficient.",
                   col.names = c("Parameter", "R-hat", "R-hat upper CI", "ESS")))

cat("\n\n All figures and tables complete.\n")
cat("Figures: fig1-fig13, sup1-sup5\n")
cat("Tables:  table1 (coverage), table2 (flu blocks), table3 (ebola blocks), table4 (cov vs N)\n")

sup6 <- (p_trace_s3 / (p_rhat_s3 | p_ess_s3)) +

    title    = "Supplementary Figure 6. MCMC convergence diagnostics — S3 (N = 500,000)",
    subtitle = "High case counts; diagnostics confirm low coverage is not due to poor mixing",

# List of outputs to check
scenarios <- list(
  "S1" = out_s1,
  "S2" = out_s2,
  "S3" = out_s3,
  "Flu (empirical)" = out_flu,
  "Ebola" = out_ebola
)

# Initialize an empty list to store diagnostics tables
diag_list <- list()

for (scen_name in names(scenarios)) {
  samp_arr <- scenarios[[scen_name]]$samples$pars
  par_names <- dimnames(samp_arr)[[1]]
  if (is.null(par_names)) {
    par_names <- c(sprintf("beta_%d", seq_len(dim(samp_arr)[1] - 1)), "I0")
  }
  n_chains <- dim(samp_arr)[3]
  
  mcmc_list <- coda::mcmc.list(
    lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(ch) {
      mat <- t(samp_arr[, , ch])
      colnames(mat) <- par_names
      coda::mcmc(mat)
    })
  )
  
  rhat_vals <- coda::gelman.diag(mcmc_list, multivariate = FALSE)$psrf
  ess_vals  <- coda::effectiveSize(mcmc_list)
  
  diag_df <- data.frame(
    Parameter   = par_names,
    R_hat       = round(rhat_vals[, 1], 3),
    R_hat_upper = round(rhat_vals[, 2], 3),
    ESS         = round(ess_vals, 0)
  )
  
  diag_list[[scen_name]] <- diag_df
  
  cat("\n========== Convergence diagnostics table (", scen_name, ") ==========\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(diag_df,
                     caption = paste("Supplementary Table. MCMC convergence diagnostics for", scen_name),
                     col.names = c("Parameter", "R-hat", "R-hat upper CI", "ESS")))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SAVE ALL FIGURES (MAIN + SUPPLEMENTARY)
# ============================================================

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

save_fig <- function(plot_obj, filename, w = 7, h = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("figures", filename),
    plot     = plot_obj,
    width    = w,
    height   = h,
    dpi      = 400,
    bg       = "white"
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# MAIN FIGURES
# ---------------------------

save_fig(fig1,  "fig1_S1_Rt_recovery.png")
save_fig(fig2,  "fig2_S2_Rt_recovery.png")

# If you re-enable Figure 4:
```
